_doc: Multi-map operations (Campaign: an offer with `legs`, each leg its own map, played back to back). Per operation: name; district (World); chance (of one on a refreshed board, HOUSE-RULE: about as rare as a set-piece gig); legs [min, max]; streetcar_minutes (the ride between legs, HOUSE-RULE: the book gives no time); event_chance (HOUSE-RULE: the campaign has no calendar date, so an event day is rolled); rival_fixers_from (the district whose fixers take jobs against the park's own fixer's gang); crowd (extra bystanders on every leg's map, Encounter opts.crowd; HOUSE-RULE: a theme park full of guests; NC2045 gives no number); gate ("conceal": weapons are banned at the gate and only concealable ones get in, Campaign.smuggles: the rest stay in the van for the whole operation); jobs = the target leg: kind (gigs.json kind: target faction and fixer tags), objective (Encounter objective, else the kind's), lands (playland.json lands that suit it), target (faction, else Campaign._target_for), title, line, pitch; approach = the legs before it ({land} is filled in).

jobs.title: Playland: the Segotari tech
jobs.line: Walk a Segotari ride tech out of the Discovery Zone.
jobs.pitch: a rival studio wants one of the techs who keep Segotari's Discovery Zone running, delivered alive.

jobs.title: Playland: the Discovery Zone prototype
jobs.line: Lift the prototype from the Discovery Zone.
jobs.pitch: Segotari is testing new ride tech on the guests; a buyer wants the prototype before it ships.

jobs.title: Playland: the yoganger
jobs.line: Get a yoganger out of the park alive.
jobs.pitch: a runaway in one of the park's yogangs wants out, and family outside is paying to get them.

jobs.title: Playland: a hit on Fantasy Island
jobs.line: Take the mark down on Fantasy Island.
jobs.pitch: someone holds court on Fantasy Island behind the Piranhas, and a client wants them gone.

jobs.title: Playland: the park's secrets
jobs.line: Pull the files the park keeps quiet.
jobs.pitch: the park buries what happens inside it; a buyer wants the files.

approach.line: Pull the staff-tunnel map from a terminal in {land}.
Kill the drone relay over {land} to open the way on.
